topics.title: Business Valuation
topics.why: CVRs bridge a gap in how buyer and seller value the target; they are valued with a modified option pricing model

topics.title: Option Pricing
topics.why: an event-driven CVR works like a call option, a price-protection CVR like a modified Asian option

topics.title: Intangible Asset
topics.why: CVRs are common where value rests on uncertain intangible assets, as in biotech and pharma

topics.title: Cost of Goods Sold
topics.why: FIFO and LIFO give different COGS for the same sales: $11,050 vs $11,800 in the Foo Co. example

topics.title: LIFO Reserve
topics.why: the FIFO–LIFO inventory difference, the amount of taxable income LIFO has deferred

topics.title: US GAAP
topics.why: LIFO is used only in the United States, under GAAP

topics.title: Save LIFO Coalition
topics.why: argues for keeping LIFO; says one third of American companies use it

topics.title: Intangible Asset
topics.why: goodwill is classified as an intangible asset because it cannot be seen or touched

topics.title: Acquisition Premium
topics.why: goodwill reflects the premium the buyer pays over the net value of the other assets

topics.title: Impairment Testing
topics.why: goodwill is tested every year and written down, never up

topics.title: US GAAP
topics.why: no amortization for public companies since FAS 142; pooling-of-interests ended by FAS 141

topics.title: Business Valuation
topics.why: businesses are bought on estimated future cash flows, not the fair value of their assets, which is why goodwill exists

topics.title: FASB
topics.why: removed goodwill amortization (FAS 142) as a concession after ending pooling-of-interests; its Private Company Council lets private companies amortize
